'''2012 US Nationals Day 2 Tom Frafjord DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tom Frafjord]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif}}
* '''Username:''' citizenSwanky
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
